item.title: Bayeux Tapestry's London tour spurs enthusiasts to Battle of Hastings reenactment
item.description: A reenactment of the Battle of Hastings, which took place almost a millennium ago, is drawing crowds of enthusiasts in the UK.
item.content:encoded: A reenactment of the Battle of Hastings, which took place almost a millennium ago, is drawing crowds of enthusiasts in the UK.

item.title: Trump weighs joining the fight against Houthis after Riyadh airport attack
item.description: The surge in attacks, including against other Saudi airports, military facilities and oil infrastructure, has come in the week since a Saudi-led coalition launched a major military offensive against the Houthis.

item.title: Protests against voter roll revisions rock capital of world's largest democracy
item.description: Parts of the capital city of India, the world's largest democracy, are on lockdown. Protests over sweeping revisions to the voter rolls were met with a massive police crackdown.
item.content:encoded: Parts of the capital city of India, the world's largest democracy, are on lockdown. Protests over sweeping revisions to the voter rolls were met with a massive police crackdown.

item.title: U.S. and Russia tout diesel deal to ease sanctions and reopen fuel flows
item.description: Moscow and Washington tout a diesel deal to ease sanctions and reopen fuel flows, but few details leave questions on price impacts and U.S. policy, sparking anger from Ukraine and allies.

item.title: Photos: What a year of ceasefire in Gaza looks like
item.description: It has been one year since Hamas released the remaining Israeli hostages and President Trump promised an end to the war, but Palestinians say the past 12 months have been a ceasefire in name only.

item.title: India cracks down on youth protests as anger grows against Modi and election chief
item.description: The protests focus on the Election Commission's voter list revision, which the opposition claims disenfranchises millions. The government denies the allegations, saying the revision aims to eliminate duplicate entries.

item.title: South African human rights lawyer Navi Pillay wins Nobel Peace Prize
item.description: South African human rights lawyer Navi Pillay wins the 2026 Nobel Peace Prize for her lifelong defense of human rights and international law.

item.title: Trump says U.S. to get diesel from Russia, relaxing pressure on Moscow to ease prices before midterms
item.description: Trump says the U.S. will obtain diesel from Russia, relaxing years of U.S. pressure on Moscow, to combat prices before midterms. He said he struck the deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin in a phone call.

item.title: Did Russia play by the rules in reporting lab worker's death?
item.description: A global treaty signed by 197 countries — including Russia — requires reporting any death that could be a sign of an outbreak to come.

item.title: Trump says U.S. won't attack Iran before midterms. And, ICE agent shoots man in NYC
item.description: Trump announced that the U.S. will not attack Iran ahead of the midterms. And, a 28-year-old man is receiving treatment at the hospital after an ICE agent shot him in the neck.
